home.introHeading: {{yearsWord}} years designing how Pakistani esports looks.
introParas: I am Rabees Sheikh, an art director and creative designer with extensive experience in the esports industry in Pakistan. I design 2D and 3D graphics and UI/UX, most recently as Senior Creative Manager at Next Generation Esports, directing branding, social campaigns and event graphics for Free Fire Esports Pakistan.

The work runs from tournament identity to LAN stage visualisation to the graphics that go out the same night. Generative video and 3D sit inside that process rather than beside it. Both are used for look development and content, art-directed to the same standard as everything else.

about.heading: Rabees Sheikh, art director and creative designer, Karachi.
intro: Art Director and Creative Designer with extensive experience in the esports industry in Pakistan. Skilled in designing 2D and 3D graphics, as well as UI/UX designing.

Most recently Senior Creative Manager at Next Generation Esports, directing branding, social media campaigns and event graphics for Free Fire Esports Pakistan, and leading a team of designers across the season.
Passionate about creating visually appealing and engaging designs that capture the essence of esports in Pakistan, now extending that practice into 3D visualisation and generative video.

experience.body: Directed a team of ten designers across branding, social media campaigns and event graphics for Free Fire Esports Pakistan, with campaign engagement up 30 per cent. Led the 3D graphics for tournaments that drew over a million views across streaming platforms, designed UI and UX assets that lifted interactions on promotional platforms by 25 per cent, and cut project turnaround by 20 per cent. Trained and mentored five junior designers.
Ran an editorial team of eight writers and designers producing more than twenty exclusive articles a month, and set the content strategy that raised reader retention by 25 per cent.
Designed graphics for esports events including social content, banners, logos and merchandise. Over a hundred pieces across campaigns, with fan engagement up 15 per cent on social platforms.
Studied advertising alongside full-time design work in esports.

recognition.body: Recognised by Next Generation Esports for leadership in directing design teams and delivering branding solutions.
Awarded at Next Generation Esports for results in campaign engagement and visual content creation.
